notes.title: Void Scout Update – v1.2 - More enemy variety, more tactical freedom and options
notes.content: [p]The latest update is here, bringing more variety and more ways to fight for survival.[/p][list][*][p][b]Enemies evolve[/b]: vulnerabilities, resistances, and new special skills mean no two fights are the same, and enemies are harder to control and bottleneck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee matters[/b]: melee weapons hit harder and stun more often, making close combat a stronger option.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical freedom[/b]: nanotech powers are now all bonus actions, so you can strike [i]and[/i] unleash abilities in the same turn. You can also move [i]after[/i] attacking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New powers[/b]: fresh nanotech skills to discover, from the devastating [i]Fury[/i] to the defensive [i]Hardening[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p]The multiverse grows more dangerous, but so too do your options. Adapt, improvise, and survive.[/p][p][/p][p]The full change list is below. Let me know what you think of the update! Whether you love it or hate it, feedback is welcome.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ Combat & Weapons[/h2][list][*][p]Player’s punch attack base damage increased to [b]2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Disposable weapons[/b] now deal [b]+1 damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sledgehammer, shovel, crowbar, and baseball bat[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shockrod[/b] stun duration increased ([b]1 → 2 turns[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flamer, Blaze, Railgun, and Zeus[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 Nanotech Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Rupture, Flare, and Rush[/b] nanotech skills now [b]stun[/b] targets. [b]Flashbang[/b] cooldown increased ([b]4 → 5[/b]) and [b]Flare[/b] cooldown increased ([b]3 → 4[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rupture, Flare, Grenade, and Flashbang[/b] nanotech are now [b]bonus abilities[/b] (can be used in addition to attacking).[/p][/*][*][p]If unused nanotech bonus powers remain, you may now trigger them at the [b]end of your turn[/b] after moving/attacking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Armor Skin[/b] buffed ([b]5/8/10 → 10/15/20[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Might[/b] buffed ([b]1/2/3 → 2/3/4[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stealth[/b] buffed ([b].15/.25/.35 → .25/.4/.5[/b]). This means enemies lose you faster and less enemies appear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardening (Passive):[/b] This [b]new nanotech[/b] reduces all damage taken after the first hit each turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scanner (Passive):[/b] Reveals hidden information on the mini-map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nanorend (Active):[/b] Deals damage to all spaces around the Void Scout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fury (Active):[/b] Make an additional attack with a carried weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]nanopairs[/b] added for these new nanotechs, with potential for eternal growth through level-ups.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Player Turn Flow[/h2][list][*][p]You can now [b]attack before moving[/b] (movement points are no longer lost when attacking).[/p][/*][*][p]After completing movement/attacking, you will now get a [b]final chance to use any bonus actions[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🧟 Enemies[/h2][list][*][p]Some enemies now have a [b]vulnerability[/b]: attacks with the right damage type deal extra damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies with vulnerabilities gain extra base HP: [b]+2 (small enemies), +5 (chonkers)[/b] - make sure to use those vulnerabilities![/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss and Chonker enemies[/b] now have [b]stacking Stable[/b] (ignore one stun attempt each turn before being affected).[/p][/*][*][p][b]All enemies[/b] gain [b]1 turn of Stable[/b] after being stunned – preventing easy stun-locking.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain enemy types now have inherent [b]special skills[/b] (not as often as bosses).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now show their [b]special skill usage[/b] in log messages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More enemies[/b] now spawn in all sectors to balance the player’s increased firepower.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💥 Environment[/h2][list][*][p]Many more [b]destructible and explosive objects[/b] added to sectors for more dynamic battlefields.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Electric barrels[/b] now apply [b]stun[/b] to adjacent enemies, other explosive objects now carry [b]elemental damage types[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📖 UI & Guide[/h2][list][*][p]New [b]in-game guide page[/b] explaining damage types, Stun, and Stable mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]tutorial message[/b] explaining movement after attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspecting analysed non-boss enemies now shows their [b]skills[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Boss health bar now displays [b]revealed skills[/b] (inherent or already used).[/p][/*][*][p]Health bars also now show the [b]Stun/Stable[/b] level of an enemy.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some [b]nanopairs[/b] had incorrect passive nanotech values.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink notes.title: Void Scout is available now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=T809_gJUuQU;full][/previewyoutube]

After countless dreaming, building, testing, and revising, [b]Void Scout[/b] is finally available.

This is a tactical roguelike about surviving the end of everything - one universe at a time. You play [b]Alyssa[/b], the Nexus Being whose mind is copied into a new reality every time she dies. The mission continues. The memories persist. And the multiverse keeps falling apart.

[h1]🎯 Strategic Combat, Decisions Matter[/h1]
Positioning, planning, and timing are the heart of Void Scout’s tactical gameplay. This isn’t about min-maxing - it’s about outsmarting enemies across procedurally shifting battlefields. Each time you play a mission will give a different challenge.

[h1]🌌 A Story That Changes With You[/h1]
This isn’t just randomized levels - it’s a living, procedural story. Each mission brings new dialogue, side plots. The multiverse is at stake, and no two realities are quite the same.

[h1]🧬 Roguelike Death, With Meaning[/h1]
In Void Scout, death isn’t failure - it’s transition. Alyssa’s mind persists across universes, learning from each life lost. What you gain, remember, or regret follows you. You’ll die many times, but every death pushes the mission forward.

notes.title: Beta Phase Engaged: The Void Beckons!
notes.content:
Void Scout has reached Beta content complete! All core missions, story elements, enemies, and mechanics are now in place. There's still refinement ahead, but the finish line is in sight. Here’s what’s new behind the scenes:

[h2]Expanded Active Skills[/h2]
Seven upgradeable active abilities now give more options for combat and survival, now including:
[list]
[*] [b]Flashbangs [/b]- Stun enemies and buy precious seconds.
[*] [b]Nanocharge [/b]- Instantly resets all nanotech cooldowns.
[*] [b]Rush [/b]- A desperate push to break through a swarm.
[*] [b]Flares [/b]- A sci-fi horror classic - damages enemies and provides lasting light.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/4b587e297bd61973e6c26240f3733b181f44354a.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Passive Skills[/h2]
Seven passive abilities help with offense, defense, and resource management, with these newly added:
[list]
[*] [b]Might [/b]- Buffs melee damage, letting you conserve ammo by fighting harder with whatever melee weapons you find - or your fists.
[*] [b]Analyst[/b] - Only increases visibility, giving little tactical advantage, but will the bonus XP gains be worth it?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/5ec782c35df56c86b97bd9f9aaa803189fb826eb.png[/img]

[h2]Pair Skills[/h2]
Maxed-out skills can now be combined into pairs and upgraded further, allowing three active and three passive abilities all at once. Find the combination that suits your style the best, to maximize your chances of survival.

[h2]Tension Events Expanded[/h2]
The Void Director has new ways to keep you off-balance with classic sci-fi surprises - steam vents suddenly block vision, doors go into lockdown, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/853bc1183f7b538fd87c024c1a1cfefb3a7c0764.png[/img]

[h2]Boss Fights Upgraded[/h2]
Boss battles are now even deadlier, featuring these new possibilities:
[list]
[*] Multi-boss encounters, for when one isn’t enough
[*] Teleporting enemies so stop you escaping
[*] Reinforcement calls and regeneration mechanics if you let the pressure drop
[*] Special attacks, attacking with surprising range or other capabilities
[/list]

[h2]All 8 Missions & Story Complete[/h2]
The full campaign is now in place, pitting the Void Scout against the infected humans, mutants, Rovakar, Zepharith, all kinds of haywire combat bots… and the Exoforms.

[h2]The Finale Is In[/h2]
The final mission and ending sequence are complete. Alyssa’s journey will reach its conclusion… but what will her fate be?

The core game is now complete, with final polish and balancing ahead. Wishlist Void Scout on Steam and follow for updates - you won’t want to miss what’s next!

notes.title: More Secrets, More Stories
notes.content:
Void Scouts, we’re continuing to build out the multiverse, adding more depth, mystery, and danger with every update. Here’s a look at what’s been added as development moves forward:

[h2]Side Plots: Distractions or Warnings?[/h2]
Missions will now feature dynamic side plots, ranging from strange discoveries to unsettling encounters. Some might reveal hidden dangers, while others could offer unexpected insight—or just leave you with more questions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/989f706b2843bfaadfeff96286f1d4b66c917d96.png[/img]

[h2]Personal Logs: Echoes of the Past[/h2]
We’re adding logs from former station occupants, scattered throughout missions for players to uncover. These will expand the story, offering glimpses into what happened before you arrived—if you take the time to find them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/55f7b0bc8824cff72075f59dc8ea9c12e925d9de.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Options: More Control[/h2]
New settings have been added, including UI scaling, screen shake toggles, key rebinding, and resolution options. We want to ensure Void Scout is as immersive and accessible as possible when it’s ready to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/387ca2fb5edbabb09c2d33d707d06347e8f0b41b.png[/img]

[h2]More Missions, More Story[/h2]
The main story continues to take shape, with two more missions now built, bringing the total to four. As we flesh out the world, the mysteries of the multiverse—and the threats within it—are becoming clearer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/1e10cb948dfd2a44c047a9ce105cf1d20eca6693.png[/img]

[h2]The Void Director Has Other Plans[/h2]
The Void Director’s influence is growing, making each mission even more unpredictable. We’ve expanded dynamic tension events, adding new ways for the environment to shift against you.Stay alert—nothing in the Void stays stable for long.

Development is moving forward, and there’s still plenty more to come. Thanks for following along as we continue shaping Void Scout—we can’t wait to share more soon.

Make sure to wishlist Void Scout and join our Discord community to stay in the loop for future updates! Follow us on X to join the adventure and help us push further into the void.

You can now also follow progress on Bluesky!

notes.title: Chaos and Choices
notes.content:
Void Scouts, the multiverse just got a lot more dangerous—and we’re here to give you a peek at what’s coming. Here’s what’s been added to make your future missions even more intense:

[h3]Boss Fights: Adaptive Nightmares[/h3]
We’ve introduced bosses with unpredictable abilities, ensuring no two boss fights will ever be the same. Each fight will demand fresh strategies, responsive tactics, and nerves of steel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/5b66375999df31b74d17ac5332cd6c3624816168.gif[/img]

[h3]Destructible Furniture: The Environment Strikes Back[/h3]
Explosive barrels and breakable obstacles now bring new layers to gameplay. Take out enemies in creative ways or clear new paths through blocked areas. More than just scenery, the terrain is a crucial strategic tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/05fc47e6c97ff0e75c1e0ba9910d04c1a7311363.gif[/img]

[h3]New Nanotech Abilities: Power in Your Hands[/h3]
We’ve expanded the arsenal of unlockable nanotech abilities, giving you new tools to outsmart or destroy the threats ahead. Whether it’s tactical evasion or raw firepower, these abilities will give you the edge you need to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/b6e1a953ff99594217277dd4a8f7078f5359c1d2.gif[/img]

[h3]Station Residents: Traces of Lives Lost[/h3]
The unfortunate remnants of station residents now populate the multiverse. Their stories reveal the depth of the world and may hold important clues for your missions. Not all signs of life are hopeful, but they’re worth investigating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267246/a3cf2c560463514bb57e1144384f7ed08c270874.png[/img]

We’re crafting a multiverse that’s as challenging as it is compelling. Keep following our updates as we push closer to bringing Void Scout to life. Stay vigilant, Scouts—the Void isn’t done evolving.
Wishlist Void Scout on Steam to stay updated on its progress, and join our Discord to connect with fellow Scouts and share your thoughts as we shape the multiverse together!

notes.title: Face the Void
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to officially announce the partnership with indie.io to bring Void Scout to players worldwide! Void Scout is a tactical roguelike where you are thrust alone into an interdimensional conflict against cosmic horrors.

Development of Void Scout began back in 2023, driven by our desire to create a game that blends unique tactical options, procedural unpredictability with nuance and depth, and a haunting sci-fi atmosphere. What keeps us going? It’s the joy of crafting Void Scout into the game we’ve always wanted to play and knowing that we’re bringing something truly special to fellow fans of deep, varied gameplay and battling horrors of the void.

[h2]Why indie.io?[/h2]

We’re excited to work with indie.io for this opportunity to share our creation with more people! I hope many more players will look forward to creeping through the void, jumping at shadows, panicking, running away, and dying alone in the darkness!

indie.io has a great track record supporting other indie developers like us, giving people a real opportunity to bring independent creativity to the gaming world!

You can see the many other great indie games indie.io have helped with here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio[/url]

[i]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/i]

[h2]Join the Void Scout Community![/h2]

Don’t forget to wishlist Void Scout and join our Discord community to stay up to date with future announcements! Follow us on X and be a part of the journey as we continue to explore the stars.

[url=https://discord.gg/rQa9nZJBw3]https://discord.gg/rQa9nZJBw3[/url]

[url=https://x.com/voidscoutgame]https://x.com/voidscoutgame[/url]

Thank you for being part of this adventure! We can’t wait to show you more of what’s to come.
